precision: CPU F64, rustfft6.4.1 scalar Radix4 / Bluestein using Radix4 inner transform

memory.innerLength: P for power2 P; nextPowerOfTwo(2P-1) otherwise
memory.fft: borrowed complex input + owned complex output + scratch + one plan peak
memory.spectrum: borrowed input + complex work P + output bins + scratch + one plan peak; windows computed without window vector
memory.convolution: borrowed complex inputs + owned output capacity P + work P + scratch + two plan peaks; output aliases first FFT buffer
